semiconductor_relevance: High — TwinSolution Technology provides critical test interface solutions essential for semiconductor testing processes.
summary: TwinSolution Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd specializes in high-performance test interface solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include test sockets, spring probes, programming sockets, burn-in sockets, and receptacles, serving nearly 1,000 customers globally. The company is recognized for its expertise in developing advanced test interface products that ensure reliability and performance in semiconductor testing.
capabilities: Test sockets for various chip packages

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shanghai, serving a global customer base.
